entities.summary: James Winright Flanagan was an American merchant, lawyer, and farmer from Henderson, Texas. Although never officially inaugurated, he briefly served as the lieutenant governor of Texas in 1870, before leaving the position to represent Texas in the United States Senate from 1870 to 1875.
